revisions.reason: the cumulative form grows monotonically while the gate waits, so it can never be satisfied by a machine that is merely idle-but-previously-busy. It measured elapsed time, not contention.
macOS deliberately keeps free memory low because most RAM is file cache; raw free memory is not a pressure signal on this OS. Active swapping is, and is now measured directly.

unchanged: 60s stabilization window, 10s samples, any violation restarts the window
